facts.claim: toggleFastMode uses filtered Xt, is enabled only !l&&!fe&&!yt&&Xt.length>1, returns early for fewer than two options, and calls setServiceTier with the next index modulo length and source composer_menu. facts.method: frozen full-program AST, lexical import/reference and source review; no target evaluation

facts.method: frozen full-program AST, lexical import/reference and source review; no target evaluation

facts.claim: Cycle uses candidate order, wraps the last index to zero, selects index zero for an unknown current effort, and returns the unchanged input for an empty list.
facts.method: frozen full-program AST, lexical import/reference and source review; no target evaluation
